span.normalized: The decrease from 2023 to 2024 of $1,170.7 million, or 14.2%, was attributable primarily to lower sales volumes across all segments, which are further explained below. There was no customer whose revenue exceeded 10% of total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2023.
